The venerable foretold that a Lord Buddha would soon enlighten the world. He then guided the people to observe the five precepts. Due to this meritorious deed, Venerable Nimittabyākaraṇīya did not fall into the lower realms for 92 world cycles. [Vitta+sutta]  CL=9 Vitta Sutta: (A discourse where the Buddha teaches about:
- "Saddhā" (faith/confidence) as the highest and most genuine wealth of beings
- "Sucarita" (good conduct/moral behavior) as that which brings happiness
- The supreme taste of "Sacca" (truth)
- Living life guided by "Paññā" (wisdom) as the most excellent way of livelihood)
This is a discourse where the Buddha points out and explains how to live life with these supreme qualities.
